author: sonnet
label: climb-07-01
changes: Added a two-sentence summary and a Requirements section listing all 8 requirements, so 'req. N' citations resolve (Q1).
Added an 'Existing system and scope' section stating the load balancer, no sticky sessions, and that consecutive requests can reach different instances (Q2).
Added the load balancer to the sequence diagram and a note after it (Q2).
Added to the storage failure table that a partial failure during login rolls back, so the attempt is not counted and no session is created (Q3).
Stated that users are provisioned outside this design and that the dummy hash uses the same bcrypt cost as real hashes; added an open question to check the cost (Q4).
Added to the session check that the app only uses user_id with no second lookup, and that page-query failures give 503 (Q5).
Stated in the lockout rules that the 429 page shows no end time and a correct password is still rejected while locked; added an open question (Q6).
Stated that logout does not validate the session first, and that other tabs are redirected to /login on their next request (Q7).
Added a short Terms section (advisory lock, fail closed, __Host- prefix, protected request) and changed the dummy hash wording to match.
Changed the cookie row to say 'req. 5' for consistency with the other citations.
Merged the separate Requirements list into the steps (limits, status codes, cookie flags, expiry) so no 'req. N' citations remain; every brief requirement is still stated once where it applies
Added the existing-system description to the summary and the load balancer to the diagram, with a note that state must be shared
Added a Terms section (session, protected request, advisory lock, fail closed, __Host- prefix, lockout)
Moved the diagram directly after summary and terms, with notes after it, per the skill

Turned the 'Rules that don't fit on the arrows' prose into four numbered steps (login, protected request, logout, cleanup), each with trigger, actions and data; merged the Identical failure, Lockout, Email handling and Fresh session rules into the login steps
Merged the sessions and failure-count rows of the Decisions table into one; trimmed why-clauses
Replaced the per-route storage-failure table and scattered failure notes with one Failures table; kept the transaction-rollback answer from Q3

Kept the added answers: no second users lookup on protected requests (Q5), 429 shows no end time and correct password is refused while locked (Q6), logout does not validate first and other tabs get redirected (Q7)
Moved the bcrypt/dummy-hash detail into login step 4 and the open question; removed the separate scope bullet on bcrypt

Cut the 'Later sections cite these' line and the duplicated tell of the flow in Decisions rows (cookie, expiry, cleanup repeated in rules); cut the second explanation of the 429 end-time reasoning ('would add a detail to build')

Kept all numbers and settings from the first version: 5 failures/10 min, 15-minute lock, 30 min idle, 12 h max, 254 char limit, 5-minute sweep, 32-byte ID, 303 redirects, cookie attributes, SQL and schema
holes: Q4: Where do the users rows and password_hash values come from? Is there a signup or admin step, and what hashing setup (bcrypt cost) is used? The dummy hash needs to match the real hashes, so how is it chosen? (author: The users table already exists; sign-up and user creation are out of scope per the brief, so rows come from outside this design. The brief does not state the bcrypt cost. The dummy hash should be generated at startup with the same cost as the real hashes, but the actual cost must be checked. Added as an open question.)
